label: RB411AR
description: MikroTik RB411AR (RB411AR) — 1x 100M RJ45, Wi-Fi 2.4 GHz. MIPSBE 1-core AR7161.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table: **PoE in: Passive PoE** (10-28 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port, and every MikroTik with a PoE-IN DC input takes it there. Max power consumption 14 W.
